subtitle_en: The day Zhang Lin stayed home from school
author: Text and translation by Claude (Anthropic)

segs.en: It was Monday morning, seven o'clock.
Mum called from the doorway, “Zhang Lin, time to get up!”
Zhang Lin didn't get up.
From his bed he said, “Mum, I don't want to get up.”

zh: 星期一早上，七点了。妈妈在门口叫：“张林，起床了！”张林没有起床。他在床上说：“妈妈，我不想起床。”

segs.en: Morning
“What's the matter?” Mum asked, coming in.
“I'm hot, and I'm tired. I don't want breakfast, and I don't want to go to school.”
Mum felt him with her hand. Zhang Lin was very hot.
Mum said, “You're ill. No school today. We're going to the hospital to see a doctor.”

zh: “你怎么了？”妈妈进来问。“我很热，也很累。我不要吃早饭，也不要去学校。”妈妈用手试了试，张林身上很热。妈妈说：“你生病了。今天不去学校了，我们去医院看病。”

segs.en: “I don't want to go to the hospital!”
Mum smiled. “The doctors at the hospital are very nice. We'll just go and see one, all right?”
Mum phoned Zhang Lin's teacher. “Hello, it's Zhang Lin's mother. Zhang Lin is ill and can't come to class today.”
The teacher said, “That's all right. Tell him to rest at home.”
They took a taxi to the hospital.

zh: “我不要去医院！”妈妈笑了：“医院的医生很好。我们去看一下，好吗？”妈妈给张林的老师打了一个电话：“老师，您好。张林生病了，今天不能上课。”老师说：“没关系。请他在家休息。”他们打车去了医院。

segs.en: At the Hospital
The hospital was full of people: old people, and little children too.
Zhang Lin and his mother waited a long time.
The doctor was a woman. She smiled and asked, “What's your name, young man?”
“I'm Zhang Lin.”
“What's wrong, Zhang Lin?”
“I'm hot and tired, and I don't feel like eating.”
“Did you sleep well last night?”
“No. I didn't sleep well.”

zh: 医院里人很多，有老人，也有小孩儿。张林和妈妈等了半天。医生是一个女医生。她笑着问：“小朋友，你叫什么名字？”“我叫张林。”“张林，你怎么了？”“我很热，很累，不想吃饭。”“昨天晚上睡好了吗？”“没有。我没睡好。”

segs.en: The doctor examined Zhang Lin and said, “It's nothing serious. You need to rest at home for a few days. Don't go to school for the next few days.”
Zhang Lin asked, “Can I watch TV?”
The doctor laughed. “Yes, a little.”
“Can I play on my phone?”
“No.”

zh: 医生看了看张林，说：“没什么。你要在家里休息几天。这几天别去学校了。”张林问：“我能看电视吗？”医生笑了：“能，看一点儿。”“能玩儿手机吗？”“不能。”

segs.en: Evening
Back home, Zhang Lin drank lots of water, ate a few noodles and went to sleep.
He slept the whole afternoon.
At six in the evening, his classmates phoned him.
“Zhang Lin, are you feeling a bit better? You weren't here today, and we all missed you!”
“The teacher says we won't start the new lesson yet. We're going to wait till you're back!”

zh: 回到家，张林喝了很多水，吃了一点儿面条儿，就睡觉了。他睡了一个下午。晚上六点，他的同学给他打电话。“张林，你好一点儿了吗？今天你没来，我们都想你！”“老师说，新课文我们先不学，要等你回来！”

segs.en: Zhang Lin sat straight up in bed. “Mum, I'm better! I want to go to school tomorrow!”
Mum felt him with her hand and smiled. “You are a little better. You're not so hot now.”

zh: 张林马上从床上起来了：“妈妈，我好了！我明天要去学校！”妈妈用手试了试，笑了：“是好一点儿了，不太热了。”

segs.en: Mum asked, “This morning you didn't want to go to school, and now you do?”
Zhang Lin laughed too. “My classmates are waiting for me!”
That night Zhang Lin was very happy. He went to bed early.

zh: 妈妈问：“早上你不要去学校，现在你要去了？”张林也笑了：“我的同学在等我呢！”这天晚上，张林非常高兴。他很早就睡觉了。
